title: Algebraic integer
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a field of characteristic $0$ (so that $\mathbf Z\subset\Omega$ through the unique ring homomorphism $\mathbf Z\to\Omega$). An element $\alpha\in\Omega$ is an *algebraic integer* if it is a root of a monic polynomial with integer coefficients: there are an integer $m\geq1$ and integers $a_0,\ldots,a_{m-1}$ such that

$$
\alpha^m+a_{m-1}\alpha^{m-1}+\cdots+a_1\alpha+a_0=0.
$$
